import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Add /world location to nginx
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cp /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/arelorian.de /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/arelorian.de.backup2")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i 's|location /api {|location /world {\\n        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;\\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\\n    }\\n\\n    location /api {|' /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/arelorian.de")
# Reload nginx
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("nginx -t && nginx -s reload 2>&1")
print("Reload:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
